headlines.snippet: Natanel Kron was murdered in a terrorist attack at a spring in Benjamin; the terrorist was captured in a Ramallah hospital. The attacker opened fire on people at the spring near Naveh Tzuf, then fled on foot. A second terrorist who attempted a ramming attack in the northern West Bank was also eliminated.

headlines.snippet: President Herzog decided to expunge Alon Azaria's criminal record, allowing him a new chapter, contrary to the Chief of Staff's position.
